say:0:1310603001:0.text: Wait, why's it so messy here again? Isn't the festival over?
say:0:1310603001:0.source_cn: 怎么屋子又是一片狼藉？祭典不是结束了吗？

say:1:1310603002:0.text: Huh? What's Lorsan doing over there?
say:1:1310603002:0.source_cn: 咦？洛桑这是在干什么啊？

say:2:1310604001:0.text: Lorsan, are you trying to act like an undead and scare us again? Hmph, Chippy's not dumb enough to fall for that a second time!
say:2:1310604001:0.source_cn: 洛桑，你又想装“尸体”吓唬人吗？哼，满满这次可不会再害怕了！

say:3:1310604002:0.text: Ah, you got me! Looks like I won't convince Gerda to reward me after all. What a bummer...
say:3:1310604002:0.source_cn: 哎呀，被你识破了！看来没办法让老板娘给我奖励了，真可惜……

say:4:1310604003:1.text: Wait a sec, didn't the festival end already? Why would Madam Gerda still reward you?
say:4:1310604003:1.source_cn: 可是……祭典不是已经结束了吗？格尔达女士还会给你奖励？

say:5:1310604004:0.text: Whoa, okay, that's the spookiest thing I've heard all day! Chippy, I'm seriously impressed. I didn't know you had such a flair for scary stories!
say:5:1310604004:0.source_cn: ……哇，你这句话才是最吓人的！满满，没想到你的恐怖天赋...

say:6:1310604005:1.text: Huh? Lorsan, what are you talking about? Weren't you supposed to come send us off in Cedartown?
say:6:1310604005:1.source_cn: 啊？洛桑，你在说什么？你不是要陪我们去雪松镇找驿车吗？

say:7:1310604006:0.text: Send you off? You're leaving already? Oh dear, I've heard it's a nightmare trying to grab a carriage with all these festival guests around. Why not hang out a bit longer?
say:7:1310604006:0.source_cn: 找驿车？你们要离开了？听说祭典期间因为客人太多，很难雇...

say:8:1310604007:1.text: Are... you pretending to be clueless again?

say:12:1310604008:0.text: Oh my, dear guests, don't mind him! This is just a part of the Ghostly Getaway experience. A little game to set the mood, you know?
say:12:1310604008:0.source_cn: 亲爱的客人，不要介意哦，这是我们为了“鬼影密室”特意设...

say:13:1310604009:1.text: Festivals are always better with a bit of a thrill, right? And I assume you're here for the Ghostly Getaway?
say:13:1310604009:1.source_cn: 祭典嘛，总是需要一些刺激才有意思，不是吗？亲爱的客人，...

say:14:1310604010:0.text: Ah, where are my manners? I'm Gerda, the innkeeper here. Follow me, sweetheart. The real fun is coming up...
say:14:1310604010:0.source_cn: 忘了自我介绍，我是这里的老板娘格尔达。大家随我来吧，接...

say:17:1310604011:0.text: Madam Gerda... don't you... recognize us?
say:17:1310604011:0.source_cn: 格尔达女士，呃，你……不认识我们了？

say:18:1310604012:0.text: Sweetheart, I may forget a bunch of faces, but yours? *Chuckle* Impossible! I mean, how many folks have hamster familiars like you do?
say:18:1310604012:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，别的人或许我会忘记，但你……哈哈，除了你们，我...

say:19:1310604013:0.text: But... isn't the festival over? I remember you and Lorsan didn't even go to the lighting ceremony because you were busy cleaning up.
say:19:1310604013:0.source_cn: 但是……祭典不是已经结束了？我记得昨天晚上你和洛桑为了...

say:20:1310604014:0.text: By Misarte! Hammie, how long did it take you to come up with this spooky tale? I admit, it's pretty scary!
say:20:1310604014:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒在上，漫漫，快告诉我，你们想了多久才想出这一套说...

say:21:1310604015:0.text: It really is! Lorsan, you should've brought them to me sooner! If I'd known, this year's Ghostly Getaway would've been even scarier and way more fun!
say:21:1310604015:0.source_cn: 的确很恐怖。哈哈哈，洛桑，你该早点把他们介绍给我认识。...

say:29:1310604017:0.text: So bizarre! Everyone seemed perfectly normal yesterday.
say:29:1310604017:0.source_cn: 好奇怪啊，昨天大家不都还是好好的吗？

say:30:1310604018:0.text: Wait, we're fine today, but something's definitely off with them... It's like their memories reset overnight!
say:30:1310604018:0.source_cn: 不对，我们今天也是好好的！但他们一点也不好……他们好像...

say:31:1310604023:0.text: Chippy has no idea... Magister, maybe we should check out the Ghostly Getaway to see if anything's weird there.
say:31:1310604023:0.source_cn: 一点头绪都没有啊……主人，不如我们就顺势去看看“鬼影密...
say:31:1310604023:0.male: Chippy has no idea... Magister, maybe we should check out the Ghostly Getaway to see if anything's weird there.
say:31:1310604023:0.female: Chippy has no idea... Magister, maybe we should check out the Ghostly Getaway to see if anything's weird there.

say:32:1310604024:0.text: I agree! Let's sneak around quietly. Remember last time? There was a real Graveborn lurking around...
say:32:1310604024:0.source_cn: 我同意满满的想法！我们可以悄悄地探查，我记得，上次在密...

say:33:1310604025:0.text: Yeah, that tall, skinny one with the two swords. Chippy remembers he wasn't dangerous, but it's definitely worth checking out.
say:33:1310604025:0.source_cn: 对，那个又瘦又高，拿着两把刀，总是佝偻着身体的活死人。...

say:34:1310604026:0.text: Right. Today, we'll conduct a thorough investigation! Maybe whatever happened is connected to that Graveborn.
say:34:1310604026:0.source_cn: 嗯，今天我们可以好好检查一番，说不定这里的怪异情况和活...

choice:28:0:1.source_cn: 他们认为祭典还没结束？

say:36:1310604019:0.text: How could they have forgotten everything overnight? That's some serious magic!
say:36:1310604019:0.source_cn: 啊，怎么会一夜之间就忘掉之前的事情呢……这太魔法了！

say:37:1310604020:0.text: It's odd, though. They only seem to have forgotten that the festival ended. Everything else is normal.
say:37:1310604020:0.source_cn: 奇怪，看起来他们只是忘了祭典已经结束，其他的事情都没有忘记。

say:38:1310604021:0.text: But that would be a pretty extreme prank... They worked so hard to clean up the inn yesterday.
say:38:1310604021:0.source_cn: 但这样恶作剧的代价也太大了，他们昨天可是好不容易才把旅...

say:39:1310604022:0.text: And Lorsan's look earlier was too genuine to be a prank.
say:39:1310604022:0.source_cn: 而且，刚才洛桑的表情很真实，根本就不像是恶作剧被拆穿的样子。

say:2:1310605001:0.text: Everyone participating in the Ghostly Getaway, this way please!
say:2:1310605001:0.source_cn: 参加“鬼影密室”项目的朋友们，请走这里呦。

say:3:1310605002:1.text: Oh yes, it's in the basement, right?
say:3:1310605002:1.source_cn: 我们知道，是在地下室举办的，对吧！

say:4:1310605003:1.text: ... You're correct, sweetheart. Here's the rulebook. If everything checks out, you can head inside and start the fun!
say:4:1310605003:1.source_cn: ……没错，亲爱的。喏，这是“游戏规则书”，如果没有问题...

say:5:1310605004:1.text: First one to escape wins a petal!
say:5:1310605004:1.source_cn: 第一位走出密室的朋友就是赢家，能得到一枚花瓣！

say:0:1310606001:0.text: The journal is still here, but this time no one spoke or knocked on the door.
say:0:1310606001:0.source_cn: 那本旅人日记还在，可是没有人说话和敲门了。

say:1:1310606002:0.text: The door didn't slam like last time either.
say:1:1310606002:0.source_cn: 这扇门也没有突然关上……

say:5:1310607001:1.text: Wait, this is totally different from before!
say:5:1310607001:1.source_cn: 咦，这次跟上次完全不一样……

say:6:1310607002:1.text: All the doors are already open, and it looks like we don't even have to solve any puzzles this time.
say:6:1310607002:1.source_cn: 所有的门都是开着的，似乎也不需要去完成那些谜题了。

choice_prompt:7:1310607002.text: All the doors are already open, and it looks like we don't even have to solve any puzzles this time.
choice_prompt:7:1310607002.source_cn: 所有的门都是开着的，似乎也不需要去完成那些谜题了。

say:8:1310607003:1.text: What a letdown... Did they forget to reset the escape room after the festival?
say:8:1310607003:1.source_cn: 真没意思……难道真的是老板娘他们在恶作剧，但是忘了把密...

say:9:1310607004:1.text: Hmm, no staff pretending to be the undead, and that Graveborn hasn't shown up either...
say:9:1310607004:1.source_cn: 唔，没有员工来假扮成活死人，那个真正的活死人也没有出现……

say:10:1310607005:1.text: This is so strange. Let's keep looking around.
say:10:1310607005:1.source_cn: 太奇怪了，我们再继续看看情况吧。

say:0:1310608001:0.text: Even the fake door has disappeared.

say:1:1310608002:0.text: Maybe we can directly find the key near that hallway painting this time!
say:1:1310608002:0.source_cn: 这样看来，说不定直接去走廊的油画那里找找，就能拿到开门...

say:0:1310609001:0.text: Wait, we actually got the key!
say:0:1310609001:0.source_cn: 真的……真的拿到开门钥匙了！

say:1:1310609002:0.text: It can't be this easy, can it?

say:2:1310609003:0.text: We didn't even run into anyone this time...
say:2:1310609003:0.source_cn: 这次什么人都没有遇见……
say:2:1310609003:0.male: We didn't even run into anyone this time...
say:2:1310609003:0.female: We didn't even run into anyone this time...

say:3:1310610001:1.text: Magister, this Ghostly Getaway feels way too simple! It's like...
say:3:1310610001:1.source_cn: 主人，我感觉这次的“鬼影密室”好简单啊！就像是……像是……
say:3:1310610001:1.male: Magister, this Ghostly Getaway feels way too simple! It's like...
say:3:1310610001:1.female: Magister, this Ghostly Getaway feels way too simple! It's like...

say:5:1310610003:1.text: Yeah! And we didn't even catch sight of that Graveborn or find any clues about him...
say:5:1310610003:1.source_cn: 没错！而且我们既没有见到那个活死人，也没有找到任何和他...

say:6:1310610004:1.text: Congratulations on being the first participants to find the exit. According to the rules... huh, where'd I put that petal?
say:6:1310610004:1.source_cn: 恭喜，你们是最先找到出口、离开密室的参与者。按照规则，...

say:7:1310610005:1.text: By the way, which "undead" impressed you the most? Who was the most realistic? I'll make sure to reward them... hmm, maybe I'll give them an extra month—no, three months—of bonus pay!
say:7:1310610005:1.source_cn: 这样吧，先说说你们觉得哪些“活死人”的表现最精彩、最逼...

say:10:1310610006:0.text: Three months' bonus pay?! If I'd known, I would've dressed up as an undead myself...
say:10:1310610006:0.source_cn: 三个月奖金！早知道，我就该去鬼影密室里扮演“活死人”才...

choice_prompt:11:1310610006.text: Three months' bonus pay?! If I'd known, I would've dressed up as an undead myself...
choice_prompt:11:1310610006.source_cn: 三个月奖金！早知道，我就该去鬼影密室里扮演“活死人”才对……<key:dialog1>

say:12:1310610007:0.text: *Sigh* Looks like their acting wasn't up to par. No good, no good. Time for some rigorous training!
say:12:1310610007:0.source_cn: 唉，看来他们的演技还不够好，不行不行，得给他们好好上上课！

say:16:1310610012:0.text: Anyway! You're our first-place winners! Once I locate that petal, I'll get it to you. I have no idea how I could've misplaced it...
say:16:1310610012:0.source_cn: 咳，总之，你们是第一名！等我好好找找花瓣放到哪里去了，...

say:20:1310610013:0.text: Even the way Madam Gerda speaks is almost identical to last time. This doesn't feel like an act...
say:20:1310610013:0.source_cn: 格尔达女士就连说的话都和上次差不多，这个样子不像是演的……

say:21:1310610014:0.text: It's all so bizarre. I'm starting to wonder if I'm dreaming...
say:21:1310610014:0.source_cn: 太奇怪了，我都要怀疑是我在做梦了……

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 没有很逼真的，都不可怕

say:23:1310610008:0.text: Huh? Does that mean I'll have to give a three months' bonus to... everyone...?
say:23:1310610008:0.source_cn: 啊？难道每个人都要多发三个月奖金……这……

choice:11:1:2.text: I was so scared by everyone!
choice:11:1:2.male: I was so scared by everyone!
choice:11:1:2.female: I was so scared by everyone!

say:27:1310610009:1.text: What do you mean, sweetheart? Was the escape room not thrilling enough for you?
say:27:1310610009:1.source_cn: 有什么问题？难道你们觉得密室还不够刺激？

say:31:1310610010:0.text: Madam Gerda, do you really not know the festival's already ended? The Magister personally lit the Eternal Flame in the ice sculpture. Chippy isn't lying!
say:31:1310610010:0.source_cn: 格尔达女士，你真的不知道祭典已经结束了吗？主人亲手为冰...
say:31:1310610010:0.male: Madam Gerda, do you really not know the festival's already ended? The Magister personally lit the Eternal Flame in the ice sculpture. Chippy isn't lying!
say:31:1310610010:0.female: Madam Gerda, do you really not know the festival's already ended? The Magister personally lit the Eternal Flame in the ice sculpture. Chippy isn't lying!

say:32:1310610011:0.text: ... You've got quite the knack for scaring people. If it were up to me, you'd be my top pick for the Chosen One.
say:32:1310610011:0.source_cn: ……亲爱的，你们的确是出色的吓人高手。要是让我来遴选，...

say:3:1310611001:0.text: Haha, judging by your pale faces, you must have been super spooked by the Ghostly Getaway!
say:3:1310611001:0.source_cn: 哈哈，看你们的脸色有点苍白，一定是被鬼影密室给吓到了。

say:4:1310611002:0.text: This year's room was my brainchild! How was it? Pretty impressive, right? I snagged the idea from an old horror story that's been told for ages in Cedartown!
say:4:1310611002:0.source_cn: 今年的密室可是我策划的，怎么样，很厉害吧？是我从一个在...

say:5:1310611003:0.text: Huh, he didn't say that the last time.
say:5:1310611003:0.source_cn: 呃……这句话倒是新的，上次没说过。

choice_prompt:6:1310611003.text: Huh, he didn't say that the last time.
choice_prompt:6:1310611003.source_cn: 呃……这句话倒是新的，上次没说过。

say:7:1310611004:0.text: Right! The Graveborn didn't pop out at us, so there's no reason for him to be here.
say:7:1310611004:0.source_cn: 今天确实没有亡灵出现，所以他没有来，也就没有打断我们的...

say:8:1310611005:0.text: Faramor? I think I've heard that name somewhere...
say:8:1310611005:0.source_cn: 法拉莫尔？呃，我应该听人提到过这个名字……

say:9:1310611007:0.text: What's with you all today? Since this morning, you've been saying some odd stuff... Got something on your mind? You should be making the most of the festival while it lasts, go have some fun!
say:9:1310611007:0.source_cn: 你们今天怎么了？从大早上开始就在说些奇怪的话……有什么...

say:10:1310611008:1.text: Ugh... Chippy envies how clueless you are...
say:10:1310611008:1.source_cn: 呃……真羡慕你什么都不知道，无忧无虑的样子啊……

say:11:1310611009:0.text: Lorsan, are you sticking around? Aren't you planning to keep traveling?
say:11:1310611009:0.source_cn: 洛桑，你还要留在这里吗？你不打算继续游历了吗？

say:12:1310611010:0.text: With such a fascinating festival, I'm not ready to bail just yet! Attending this festival is a journey of its own, it's a whole different ballgame compared to festivals in the forest.
say:12:1310611010:0.source_cn: 哈，这么有趣的祭典，我可不舍得走！参加祭典也是一种游历...

say:13:1310611011:0.text:
Plus, according to my agreement with the lovely Madam Gerda, I'm stuck here working for another two weeks!
Aren't you all heading to Cedartown to check out the other activities?
say:13:1310611011:0.source_cn: 而且，按照和美丽的格尔达女士的约定，我还得在这里工作半...

say:14:1310611012:1.text: We probably should... I wonder if they're celebrating the festival over there again.
say:14:1310611012:1.source_cn: 的确应该回去，不知道那里是不是和这边一样，又开始庆祝祭...

say:15:1310611013:1.text: Magister, let's head to Cedartown and see what's happening there!
say:15:1310611013:1.source_cn: 主人，我们回雪松镇去看看吧！
say:15:1310611013:1.male: Magister, let's head to Cedartown and see what's happening there!
say:15:1310611013:1.female: Magister, let's head to Cedartown and see what's happening there!

say:17:1310611006:0.text: Mhmm, that tall, skinny one didn't make an appearance either.
say:17:1310611006:0.source_cn: 的确，那个又瘦又高的活死人也没有出现。

choice:6:1:2.text: The undead didn't show up either.
choice:6:1:2.male: The undead didn't show up either.
choice:6:1:2.female: The undead didn't show up either.
